messages:
Mia (SEO): Heads-up: we need a small "URL safety box" for the launch posts + webinar landing. Focus: redirect canonicals, anchor hygiene for conversion tracking, lead attribution param, and a quick schema sanity check. Can we keep it tiny and actionable?
Diego (Content): I'll mark the CTAs in each post and the webinar landing with explicit anchor text. Plan: unique anchor per funnel stage (hero, mid-article, footer).
Zara (Growth): For attribution let's send page_src param with form submits (page_src=benchmark_post or page_src=webinar_landing) + utm_campaign. That way CRM gets the exact page.
Kevin (Dev): OK. We can add middleware to append page_src hidden input on form render when a CTA is clicked and set Link rel=canonical header on responses. Where should the redirect sheet live?
Mia (SEO): Put mappings in marketing/seo/redirects.csv (simple CSV so non-devs can edit). Keep only explicit mappings; avoid open regex unless necessary.
Liam (Prod Marketing): A quick note on anchors: avoid repeating the same exact anchor text more than once per page; it causes anchor decay in our click-through signals. Also add data-attr data-seo-anchor="hero-benchmark" etc.
Diego (Content): I'll add anchor annotations in the drafts and include the page_src values for each CTA. Dropping doc in #marketing-drafts in 30m.
Kevin (Dev): Example redirect CSV row I'll add to repo: from,to,status,reason
"/old-benchmark-2022","/benchmark-latency","301","remove date prefix"
Also plan to strip ad params: fbclid,gclid,_gl,amp and preserve utm_* and page_src.
Mia (SEO): Schema microcheck: benchmark = Article schema with mainEntityOfPage; webinar landing = Event + WebinarEvent; confirmation page = noindex but include EventAttendance schema server-side. Keep FAQ minimal (1-2 Qs) on landing.
Zara (Growth): For routing, if page_src missing, tag leads as "launch_unknown" so sales knows to verify. We'll update CRM mapping.
Kevin (Dev): ETA: redirect CSV + middleware + basic smoke test by Friday AM. Smoke test will verify sample legacy -> canonical 301 and that form submission includes page_src and utm_campaign.
seo-bot: Reminder: schedule a quick crawl after merge. Last shallow crawl 2024-06-01 showed 197 warnings.
Mia (SEO): Great. Goal: all the tiny pieces done 48h before QA freeze. I'll compile a two-bullet QA: 1) canonical & redirect check, 2) form payload & schema sanity. Ping me if blockers.
